subject: Selection of Three Final School Name Candidates
overview: The committee reduced the list of potential names for the Columbus School and selected three finalists—Belinda Sutton, Jean Barry Sutherland, and Missituk—to recommend to the School Committee. Members also approved a resolution to transfer all research and public records to the School Committee to aid their final decision.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting with corrections regarding specific terminology and the definition of a voting majority.

items.title: Public Correspondence
items.summary: Heard letters from school educators requesting a geographic or landmark name to avoid controversy and from the Italian American Alliance expressing opposition to the renaming process.

items.title: Initial Candidate List Reduction
items.summary: Eliminated five names from the list of 18 candidates—Achi Sulo, Crispus Attucks, Ruth Bader Ginsburg, Sagamore John, and Wampanoag—after no committee members objected to their removal.

items.title: Finalist Advocacy and Statements
items.summary: Committee members presented individual advocacy statements for their top candidates, discussing historical significance, community service, and local impact.

items.title: Selection of Final Three Nominees
items.summary: Approved a motion to advance Belinda Sutton, Jean Barry Sutherland, and Missituk as the committee’s three final recommendations to the School Committee.

items.title: Resolution to Share Records with School Committee
items.summary: Approved a resolution to provide the School Committee with all agendas, survey data, research, and records compiled during the renaming process.

items.title: Presentation Planning
items.summary: Tasked a subcommittee with drafting the final presentation for the School Committee meeting scheduled for June 7th.
